title: Data cleanup, step 2: passes that act by rule, with a ledger, Undo and one Pulse case
why: Jason, 2026-11-14 (in chat): "build step 2" of Insights → Data cleanup (decisions/0163 §8 stage 1b, 0164 §6.1b), after step 1's preview (release #49: 4,395 records). A pass acts by rule, never on what a person entered or decided (R4: those are Check these): listings with a page-text name, no address or phone, or resting only on cite-only pages are taken off the public site and kept (is_suppressed + the 'removed' note the editor's Put back reads; target quarantine, sighting or "Help us find", that card not built yet); OpenStreetMap-only values marked not yet confirmed (an 'unconfirmed' note: How we know says so and confidence drops); a one-site Closed becomes a caution (closed_signal, "Still open? One site said it closed"); duplicates are offered in Review (now only pairs the intake's own test, AutoImport::relationTo, calls one business: providers at one clinic and businesses sharing a building aren't duplicates, decisions/0074; at most 60 open at once); staged finds quarantined; place-store entries held; protected and nation-sensitive landmarks held as Hidden by us (survives the monthly reload; story only planned). Wikipedia text (Jason: "find a replacement before it's stripped"): a pass queues each landmark's own description (Place descriptions, inside the AI cap; Write 10 now on the page, greyed while AI use or automation stops it) and clears the text only where that exists; title and link kept. Also closes two leaks of Wikipedia's words: search's place card (UniversalSearch::peekOutdoors) and guide name tags (ContentTags::card) now use Landmarks::about like the landmark page. Ledger: every change with old and new value, who, when and the device's time zone; Undo per record or per pass, leaving anything changed since as it is now. One Pulse case "Data cleanup needs a person": a step per kind (Looked at them; Open the list), merge offers to answer, the last pass's report. Up to 600 records a press, Continue carries on. Daily pass (data_cleanup_tick): in Scheduler::JOBS and Automation::JOBS (W1, under the master switch), not in AUTO, and switched off on the page. The page is now a card per rule (fits a phone). Migration: four new tables only (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS). FAQ: the two staff entries updated.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
